verdict.rationale: Letta strongly documents persistent, cross-session memory (stateful agents, /remember, MemFS, dreaming/consolidation, /search across agents) so memories added in conversation clearly persist and can be recalled later. However, semantic search is explicitly gated behind an optional add-on: docs state 'For keyword search and optional semantic or hybrid search, install the [MemFS Search mod]', and Letta's own team frames its memory as primarily text/file-based rather than RAG/embedding-based, contrasting with typical semantic-search memory stores. missing for 10: native out-of-the-box semantic search without installing a mod, independent benchmarking of retrieval quality, and hands-on confirmation the mod delivers accurate semantic recall.
